definitions.gloss: tail of an aircraft; tail assembly; tail fin
definitions.explanation: The tail section at the rear of an aircraft, including the vertical and horizontal stabilizers, which keeps the plane stable in flight.

examples.japanese: {飛行機|ひこうき}の{尾翼|びよく}。
{尾翼|びよく}に{航空会社|こうくうがいしゃ}のマークが{描|えが}かれている。
examples.english: The airline's logo is painted on the tail.

examples.japanese: {尾翼|びよく}は{機体|きたい}の{姿勢|しせい}を{安定|あんてい}させる{重要|じゅうよう}な{部分|ぶぶん}だ。
examples.english: The tail is an important part that keeps the aircraft's attitude stable.

notes:
The tail assembly of an aircraft. Built from {尾|び} (tail) and {翼|よく} (wing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {垂直|すいちょく}{尾翼|びよく}: vertical stabilizer (vertical tail fin)
- {水平|すいへい}{尾翼|びよく}: horizontal stabilizer
- {尾翼|びよく}のマーク: the logo on the tail

RELATED WORDS:
- {主翼|しゅよく}: main wing
- {機体|きたい}: aircraft body; airframe
